 Actor and musician Indio Downey, the son of Marvel Cinematic Universe icon Robert Downey Jr. , is following in his father's footsteps. He has just booked his first-ever leading role in a feature film.
 Add CBR on Google 
 Add as Preferred Source

 Per Deadline , the younger Downey will play the lead in the upcoming indie movie Love in Vein . The feature film is an adaptation of the 2014 novel Wasting Talent , a semi-autobiographical story about addiction written by late author Ryan Leone. Will De Los Santos ( Spun ) wrote the script and is directing the adaptation. Muse Productions will produce in association with ArtHouse Gooning. Chris Hanley ( American Psycho ) will also serve as a producer alongside Orson Oblowitz, Tricia van Klaveren, and Ben D. Wallace.
 Indio Downey Takes Center Stage in Love in Vein
 Promise2Live 4th Annual Global Livestream event at Avalon Theatre Image via Carla Van Wagoner/Future Image/Cover Images 
 Hanley previously worked with the elder Downey as a producer on Two Girls and a Guy . On teaming up with the Iron Man star's son, the producer stated, "I’m thrilled to be making another film with a Downey. I produced Two Girls and a Guy with Robert many years ago, and now getting to work with Indio on Love in Vein feels like a wonderful full-circle moment. Indio brings exactly the vulnerability and authenticity this role needs."
 "Ryan left behind a brutally honest novel about addiction, love and Los Angeles," De Los Santos also said about the late author of Wasted Talent . "Since his passing, making Love in Vein has taken on an even deeper meaning for me. I want to honor his voice and the rawness of the book without softening its edges."
 In Love in Vein , Indio Downey is playing the role of Damien, the main character. He is described as a troubled person who "navigates addiction, love and self-destruction." The story is "set against LA’s underground landscape" and "follows Damien through a fragile collision of drugs, relationships, music and survival as the people around him struggle with their own versions of desire, dependency, and escape.”
 The "Tarantino-esque" Novel Gets an Official Adaptation
 The cover art for Wasted Talent (2014) Image via Catharsis Fiction 
 "One of the more f***ed up and honest depictions of addiction I’ve ever read," American Psycho author Bret Easton Ellis said about the original book. "A Tarantino-esque journey into so-cal madness... one of the better books I’ve read about millennials by a millennial."
 Downey, who's 33 years old, is the oldest of RDJ's three children. He has had minor roles in previous films, which includes appearing in his father's Kiss Kiss Bang Bang at the age of nine. He more recently had a role in Jonah Hill's dark comedy Outcome , starring Keanu Reeves. Aside from acting, Downey is also a musician. He released his debut solo EP, Cigarettes in Bed , in 2024. Downey's mother, RDJ's ex-wife Deborah Falconer, is also a musician.
 Love in Vein does not yet have a release date, but is scheduled to start shooting in Los Angeles in March and April 2027.
